context_notes: 2026-10-09 lessons: (1) terse screenshot complaints ('its all empty', 'like this') were guessed wrong three times; one concrete example settled the design, so ask one plain question with an example before building. (2) A hot update can silently not reach the phone: take a screenshot after every app edit and restart the app at a boundary if unchanged. (3) The developer hates typing in tests: use accounts made through the API (try5@example.com, username try_five, password abcdefgh1) and keep the check short. (4) Adding a nullable column is backward compatible: apply migrations to the dev database BEFORE restarting the API; the API does not migrate itself; migrate CLI is ~/go/bin/migrate; the 0002 migration test restores version 2. (5) Several earlier rules still hold: never restart the phone app mid-flow after a sign-up (page 2 is in memory), Home-and-tap does not reload the app, edit a screen in ONE write, single quotes in prose here, no em dashes.
